map.预缴所得税 = 利润 × 税率: Income tax prepaid = profit × tax rate
map.预缴按账面利润暂估、分季缴纳；汇算按税法口径调整永久性差异与暂时性差异后确定全年: Prepayment estimates on the accounting profit and is paid quarterly; the annual settlement adjusts permanent and temporary differences under the tax rules to determine the full-year tax payable, and the difference against what was already prepaid is refunded or topped up.
map.：某企业前三季度累计利润总额 300 万元，适用税率 25%，累计已预缴 50: : a company has a cumulative total profit of 3 million CNY over the first three quarters, an applicable rate of 25% and 500,000 CNY already prepaid; with a cumulative profit of 4 million CNY this quarter, the payable = 400×25%−50 = 500,000 CNY, so 500,000 CNY must be prepaid this quarter.
